_comment: Programme registry for /design-pipeline. One entry per design system. Adding a programme means adding an entry here - no skill or script edits. Routing key is the 'Design system' field of the design-handoff issue, matched case-insensitively against a programme's key or label. NOTE: the issue form's 'Design system' dropdown in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/design-handoff.yml duplicates the enabled labels below - GitHub issue forms cannot read this file. Keep the two in sync when enabling a programme.

ids.label: IDS
ids._designProjectNote: claude.ai design-system project UUID. Resolve once via DesignSync list_projects during the first resync, then record it here.

dap.label: DAP
dap._note: DAP is programme deltas layered on IDS (see CLAUDE.md). A DAP handoff may need the IDS base component inspected for context, but must never edit it.

powerflex.label: Powerflex
powerflex._note: Sources exist but storybook/.storybook/main.ts does not index storybook-generated/powerflex/src. Add it to the storyFiles list there before enabling.
